purpose: Source discovery and verification tracking for Pakistan undergraduate admissions. A source record does not mean every program rule at that university has been verified.

verification_policy.verified: A specific rule was checked against the cited official source for the named cycle and program/campus.
verification_policy.partially_verified: Official source is identified and some general criteria are visible, but program/campus/cycle coverage is incomplete.
verification_policy.unverified: Source is listed for research discovery; no program-specific rule has been asserted from it.
verification_policy.stale: Previously verified information is beyond the configured refresh window or its cycle has expired.
verification_policy.conflicting: Official sources disagree; evaluation must remain indeterminate until resolved.
